learnings.note: No reels live yet on either account (0 media returned), so no metrics; keep the baseline format until the first posts have data.
Hashtags must be plain # in captions; %23 shows up literally.

Day 1 EN: 112 reach but avg watch only 5.4s of ~35s and 0 saves; ML held 17.5s. Viewers leave during the hook. Today change one variable: EN hook states the payoff immediately (claim, not a feeling question). Compare EN avg watch time tomorrow.
Adhil asked for more varied animations in future videos; see PLAYBOOK §4 'Motion variety'.

Afternoon check: the EN payoff-statement hook did not help IG watch time (3.9s vs 5.3s on day 1; first save though). The standout is YouTube Malayalam Shorts: 1,241 views/26 likes (day 1) and 257 views (day 2, same day) vs 11 and 0 for EN Shorts, while IG Malayalam reach is near zero. Next run: keep Malayalam as-is (it's the audience that's watching); for EN test a 2-3s visual-first hook (Arabic verse card on screen from frame 1 with a short spoken line) instead of text over the arch corridor.

Run blocked: Composio in this session only has the @scplksa Instagram account (no instagram_purga-talari / instagram_semic-ratio, no YouTube), so no metrics; and fetches to quran.com, api.quran.com and sunnah.com were refused (permission prompts unanswered in the unattended run), so sources could not be verified and no reel was made.
